name: Boop never makes the wrong face
case: Over a mixed stretch of work (tests failing, then passing after failing, a long turn finishing well, then a new turn failing on an error), Boop's faces always fit what just happened. A failure never gets a happy, excited, proud, calm or engaged face, or a success. A win never gets an annoyed, irritated, grumpy, whiny, wounded or sad face, or a failure.
why: Each face's meaning (annoyed, determined, irritated, grumpy and whiny for failures, sad and wounded only for a big one; happy, excited, proud, calm and engaged for wins), and react.move's: a success only for a turn done, a failure for one that failed
